title: Petition of the Taunton Municipal Lighting Plant for authorization and approval of an increase in the depreciation rate from the statutory rate of three percent to five percent for the year 1990.
filings: ORDER ISSUED. Commissioners: Werlin, Tierney, Alexander (90-11B).
Taunton Municipal Lighting Plant, for authorization and approval of an increase in depreciation rate on the cost of plant from 3% to 5% for the year of 1990.
